note: Databricks AI Platform manages the end-to-end ML lifecycle from features and training to serving and governance.
Feature Store manages governed features for training and serving, with an online store on Lakebase.
Unity Catalog governs feature metadata to enable discovery, lineage tracking, and cross-workspace sharing.
Model Serving provides serverless endpoints with pay-per-token, provisioned throughput, and batch billing.
Deploys any custom model behind a serverless endpoint that scales to high request volumes.
Foundation models including Llama, Qwen, Gemini and GPT are hosted on Databricks.
Provides real-time feature enrichment during inference by serving features directly from Feature Store.
Serverless GPU access for fine-tuning, distributed training, and batch inference with A10 and H100 instances.
Provides GPU access in notebooks and jobs for interactive and batch workloads.
MLflow provides end-to-end tracing for 30+ frameworks, LLM-based evaluation, and production monitoring.
Automatically traces agent and LLM calls across 30+ frameworks using OpenTelemetry-compatible instrumentation.
Evaluates LLM outputs using LLM judges that score safety, correctness, and relevance.
Monitors production metrics including quality, safety, and latency with alerting.
Manages model versions, aliases for production stages, and Unity Catalog lineage.
Tracks data lineage through training and models to inference for full provenance visibility.
Stores model parameters, temperature settings, and prompts together for reproducibility.
Retrieves versioned prompts via API for side-by-side comparison to review prompt evolution.
Logs AutoML trials to MLflow with metrics, parameters, and generated notebooks.
AI Search combines vector and keyword search with reranking, Delta sync, and citation tracking.
Automatically synchronizes search indexes from Delta tables and attributes results with source citations.
QLoRA uses 4-bit quantized adapters to reduce GPU memory while maintaining comparable model quality.
Retrains complete model weights, requiring substantial GPU memory for gradients and optimizer state.
Agentic Data Management automates data classification, quality monitoring, and anomaly detection within a governed lakehouse.
Provides AI-driven data classification and quality monitoring integrated with Unity Catalog.
Automatically profiles schema, distributions, and data quality indicators.
Detects anomalies in data with automated remediation capabilities that are still emerging.
Lakehouse//RT provides serverless SQL query execution for real-time analytics on Delta and Iceberg tables.
Executes SQL queries with millisecond-scale latency for real-time analytics.
Provides read-only SQL access while transactional writes go through Lakebase.
LTAP combines transactional processing and analytics in a unified lakehouse platform.
Stores data once to eliminate synchronization pipelines and dual writes.
Eliminates data redundancy to simplify architecture and reduce operations overhead.
CustomerLake delivers agentic capabilities for customer profiles, identity resolution, and campaign management.
Unifies customer identity across behavioral, transactional, and operational data sources.
Matches customers across data sources using deterministic, probabilistic, and agent-assisted techniques.
Activates customer audiences to data destinations including Adobe, Meta and Braze.
Uses Lakehouse storage with Unity Catalog permissions governing data access.
Lakewatch provides agentic security information and event management with Panther integration.
Correlates security events with business context and IT logs for unified threat assessment.
Panther was acquired by Databricks in 2026 to integrate over 100 prebuilt security connectors.
Row Zero integrates spreadsheets with Genie for automated data remediation and ML-driven insights.
This feature is public-only, verify status and naming before customer use.
